name: d.velop documents
description: d.velop documents (d.3one) DMS: search the repository, read document metadata and source properties, list repositories and categories. REST API on d.velop cloud or on-premises, bearer API key.
instructions:
**Getting an API key**
1. In d.velop cloud open **Konfiguration → API-Schlüssel** (or, on premises, the identityprovider app) and create an API key for a technical user.
2. Give that user read rights on the repositories the agent should reach. d.velop applies its permission model per document, so a restricted user quietly sees a smaller repository.
3. Set `DVELOP_URL` to your tenant root — `https://<tenant>.d-velop.cloud` for cloud, or your own host on premises — and `DVELOP_API_KEY` to the key.

**The Authorization header is `Bearer <apikey>`**, with the API key used directly as the bearer token. d.velop's API keys are long-lived; rotate them the way you would rotate a password.

**Repository ids come first.** d.velop can host several repositories in one tenant and every document operation is scoped to one. Call `d_velop_list_repositories` and keep the `id` — it is an opaque string, not a number.

**Responses are HAL JSON.** `d_velop_list_repositories` returns `repositories[]` (`id`, `name`); a search returns `items[]`, each with `id`, `sourceProperties` and `sourceCategories`, plus `_links.next.href` for the next page. `page` starts at 1 and `pageSize` defaults to 25.

**Every search and document read needs a source id.** d.velop maps its internal properties to a *source*, and the search (`/srm`) and document (`/o2m`) endpoints return property values only through that mapping: `sourceid` is required. Call `d_velop_list_categories` first: it returns the repository's default source with its `id` (normally `/dms/r/<repositoryId>/source`), its category keys and its property keys. Use that `id` as `sourceid`, the category keys in `sourcecategories` and the property keys in `sourceproperties`.

**Not run against a live tenant.** The paths and parameters follow d.velop's DMSApp OpenAPI specification (help.d-velop.de/dev/documentation/dms-app); d.velop does not offer a public sandbox. If you run this against a real system, a correction to the adapter JSON is genuinely welcome.

**Read-only by design**: no upload, no property change. A DMS is the audit trail, and an agent should not be able to edit it by accident.

tools.name: d_velop_list_repositories
tools.description: List the repositories in this d.velop tenant with their id, name and supported features. Start here — every other tool needs a repository id.

tools.name: d_velop_get_repository
tools.description: Read one repository's definition: its name, the sources (index definitions) it exposes and the operations it supports.

tools.name: d_velop_search_documents
tools.description: Search a repository by full text and/or property and category filters, through a source's mapping. Returns items with their source property values; follow _links.next.href or raise page for more.

sourceid.description: Source id: the `id` returned by d_velop_list_categories, normally /dms/r/<repositoryId>/source. Required: without it d.velop returns only ids and links.

sourcecategories.description: JSON array of category keys from d_velop_list_categories, e.g. ["d42018fc-..."].

sourceproperties.description: JSON object mapping property keys from d_velop_list_categories to arrays of values, e.g. {"<propertyKey>":["12345"]}.

sourcepropertysort.description: Property key to sort by (default: last modified).

tools.name: d_velop_get_document
tools.description: Read one document's details through a source's mapping: its category, property values and link relations.

documentId.description: Document id as returned by a search.

sourceid.description: Source id: the `id` returned by d_velop_list_categories, normally /dms/r/<repositoryId>/source. Required: without it d.velop returns only ids and links.

tools.name: d_velop_get_document_versions
tools.description: Read the version history of one document — who changed it, when, and with what comment. The audit answer for 'which version did the auditor see'.

tools.name: d_velop_list_categories
tools.description: Read the repository's default source: its id (the sourceid every search and document read needs), its categories (Dokumentarten) and its properties, each with the key to use in a search filter and a display name.
